name: B10-0076/2025 (Verts/ALE) – Russia’s disinformation and historical falsification to justify its war of aggression against Ukraine
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Russia’s disinformation and historical falsification to justify its war of aggression against Ukraine
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on the European Union and its member states to fight Russian disinformation and false history used to justify the war against Ukraine. It asks for stronger enforcement of existing laws on social media and political advertising, tighter rules on how platforms recommend content, and new sanctions. It also wants funding for researchers and support for independent Russian media in exile. The text is a statement of position and requests; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. It asks for stricter enforcement of existing rules and new sanctions.
- **Who it affects:** Social media platforms, political advertisers, researchers, and exiled Russian media.
- **What happens next:** The text goes to the Council, Commission and member states for follow-up.
